name: Representation Evolution, Feedback, and Spatial Agent Work
description: How immutable ASCII revisions become indexed representation layers, evolve through feedback and recipes, and scope spatial agent progress.

codeEntities.label: DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists the ASCII revision hash and spatial evidence mappings used to build a representation index.

codeEntities.label: buildRepresentationIndex
codeEntities.summary: Builds the requested tree or diagram index after checking that its mapping belongs to the current artifact revision.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationIndex
codeEntities.summary: Unifies stable tree-node and exact diagram-element indexes under one revision-bound representation type.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationGraphRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists a representation graph's layers, directed transitions, revisioned recipes, and user feedback.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationLayerRecord
codeEntities.summary: Binds an information rank and representation kind to one immutable artifact revision and its evidence references.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationTransitionRecord
codeEntities.summary: Defines a directed refinement edge between two representation layers with optional evidence and recipe bindings.

codeEntities.label: assertRepresentationGraph
codeEntities.summary: Enforces graph identity, acyclicity, increasing information rank, valid feedback targets, and valid recipe revisions.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationFeedbackRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists a timestamped user comment targeting one representation layer or transition.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationRecipe
codeEntities.summary: Persists one revision of the instruction used to produce or refine a layer or transition.

codeEntities.label: reviseRepresentationRecipe
codeEntities.summary: Creates the next recipe revision while verifying and recording incorporated feedback for the same target.

codeEntities.label: AgentWorkScope
codeEntities.summary: Pins agent work to an immutable representation revision and an artifact, structural element, subtree, or evidence target.

codeEntities.label: resolveAgentWorkScope
codeEntities.summary: Resolves an ID-only work scope into stable ordered element identities and tree or grid locations.

codeEntities.label: SpatialProgressState
codeEntities.summary: Tracks the current, visited, and completed representation elements for one scoped agent run.

codeEntities.label: updateSpatialProgressState
codeEntities.summary: Applies a validated progress event while preserving monotonic visited and completed sets in representation order.

codeEntities.label: mapCodeEntitiesBatch
codeEntities.summary: Runs bounded concurrent mapping agents and persists revision-bound mappings and per-run spatial progress.
